labels.class.druid.blurb: Moon, storm and growth. Roots, hurricanes and the steadiest self-healing.
labels.class.druid.name: Druid
labels.class.hunter.blurb: Death from range. Arrows, traps and volleys, as long as you keep your distance.
labels.class.hunter.name: Hunter
labels.class.mage.blurb: The glass cannon. The biggest area damage in Azeroth, and nothing to hide behind.
labels.class.mage.name: Mage
labels.class.paladin.blurb: Holy ground and righteous hammers. Heals himself, shrugs off death once in a while.
labels.class.paladin.name: Paladin
labels.class.priest.blurb: Light and Shadow. Shields and heals keep you alive while pain spreads through the horde.
labels.class.priest.name: Priest
labels.class.rogue.blurb: Fast, fragile and lethal. The quickest hero, with crits that delete elites.
labels.class.rogue.name: Rogue
labels.class.shaman.blurb: Storms that jump from foe to foe, and totems that fight beside you.
labels.class.shaman.name: Shaman
labels.class.warlock.blurb: Curses and fire. Damage over time stacks up on everything that chases you.
labels.class.warlock.name: Warlock
labels.class.warrior.blurb: Unstoppable in the thick of it. Huge health, cleaving swings, and every kill feeds the fury.
labels.class.warrior.name: Warrior

labels.lore.druid.0: Sharp as the great cat's claws.
labels.lore.druid.1: Thick as the hide of the great bear.
labels.lore.druid.2: Nature's gifts return swiftly to its wearer.
labels.lore.druid.3: Swift as the stag, sure as the claw.
labels.lore.druid.4: Wise as the moonkin; nature mends between spells.
labels.lore.druid.5: The Emerald Dream sustains its wearer.
labels.lore.druid.6: Made for the hunt, at the pace of the pack.
labels.lore.druid.7: Nature's wrath reaches far and strikes true.
labels.lore.hunter.1: Cut from a beast that would not die.
labels.lore.hunter.2: Keen-eyed and tireless, ever ready to loose again.
labels.lore.hunter.3: Light on the trail, sure on the shot.
labels.lore.hunter.4: The patient hunter rests, and readies the next trap.
labels.lore.hunter.5: Made for long seasons in the wild.
labels.lore.hunter.6: Runs with the pack, and bites with it.
labels.lore.hunter.7: From high above, nothing escapes its reach.
labels.lore.mage.1: Its threads hold a ward of frost.
labels.lore.mage.2: Its weave hastens the next spell.
labels.lore.mage.3: Lighter than air, and precise as a blink.
labels.lore.mage.4: The arcane mends its wearer between spells.
labels.lore.mage.5: Enchanted to endure what would fell lesser magi.
labels.lore.mage.6: Spells loosed on the move, and loosed hard.
labels.lore.mage.7: Its blizzards fall wider and bite deeper.
labels.lore.paladin.0: Blessed for the smiting of the wicked.
labels.lore.paladin.1: Consecrated steel: the Light turns the blow aside.
labels.lore.paladin.2: The Light answers its bearer's prayers swiftly.
labels.lore.paladin.3: Swift is the hand of justice, and sure.
labels.lore.paladin.4: Faith mends its bearer between judgements.
labels.lore.paladin.5: The Light keeps its bearer standing past mortal limits.
labels.lore.paladin.6: For the crusader who rides down the Scourge.
labels.lore.paladin.7: Its holy radiance spreads wide and burns true.
labels.lore.plain.0: Plain work, but it helps a blow land where it hurts.
labels.lore.plain.1: Sturdy, if nothing much to look at.
labels.lore.plain.2: Well fitted; it keeps its wearer fresh and ready.
labels.lore.plain.3: Light and well cut; it never slows you down.
labels.lore.plain.4: Simple, comfortable, and easy to rest in.
labels.lore.plain.5: Thick and warm, made for long days on the road.
labels.lore.plain.6: Cut for moving quickly and hitting hard.
labels.lore.plain.7: Its maker had a good eye, and so will its wearer.
labels.lore.priest.0: Holy wrath and shadow alike strike true.
labels.lore.priest.2: Its wearer's prayers are answered swiftly.
labels.lore.priest.3: Light of step and certain of word.
labels.lore.priest.5: Blessed to sustain its wearer through any trial.
labels.lore.priest.6: The zealot's garb, made to walk into the fray.
labels.lore.priest.7: Its blessings reach far and fall true.
labels.lore.rogue.0: Made for the strike that ends it.
labels.lore.rogue.1: Studded beneath the shadows, for the fight that goes wrong.
labels.lore.rogue.2: Its wearer is never caught without a trick ready.
labels.lore.rogue.3: Quick feet, and a quicker blade in the back.
labels.lore.rogue.4: Catch your breath in the shadows; the next trick is ready.
labels.lore.rogue.5: For the one who walks out of every ambush.
labels.lore.rogue.7: Its knives fan wide and find the vitals.
labels.lore.shaman.0: The fury of the storm, bound in its runes.
labels.lore.shaman.1: Blessed by the spirits of the earth.
labels.lore.shaman.2: The elements answer its wearer without delay.
labels.lore.shaman.3: The wind carries its wearer, and guides the strike.
labels.lore.shaman.4: Water's patience: it heals, and it returns.
labels.lore.shaman.5: The tides restore its wearer, again and again.
labels.lore.shaman.6: The spirit wolf runs at its wearer's side.
labels.lore.shaman.7: Its lightning leaps far and strikes true.
labels.lore.warlock.0: Fel runes along its seams hunger for the kill.
labels.lore.warlock.2: The pact grants life, and spells that return sooner.
labels.lore.warlock.3: Shadow hastens its wearer and guides the curse home.
labels.lore.warlock.4: Life siphoned from the dying mends its wearer.
labels.lore.warlock.5: Its wearer's life is anchored by a bound soul.
labels.lore.warlock.6: Felhunter leather, made for the chase.
labels.lore.warlock.7: Its shadowflame spreads far and burns deep.
labels.lore.warrior.0: Notched by a hundred killing blows.
labels.lore.warrior.1: Hammered thick enough to turn an axe.
labels.lore.warrior.2: Worn by those who never tire of the charge.
labels.lore.warrior.3: Light enough to reach the foe first, and find the gap in its armor.
labels.lore.warrior.4: A veteran's gear: the wounds close, and the next blow is ready.
labels.lore.warrior.5: Made for those who bleed and keep standing.
labels.lore.warrior.6: Made for running down what flees.
labels.lore.warrior.7: Every sweep of the blade carries further.
labels.opt.ALWAYS_SHOW_MULTIBARS.tip: Check this option to always display extra actionbars.
labels.opt.AUTO_QUEST_WATCH.tip: Quests are automatically watched for 5 minutes when you achieve a quest objective.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_FLOAT_MODE.tip: Sets the direction that combat text scrolls.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURAS.tip: Shows a message when the player gains an aura.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURA_FADE.tip: Shows a message when an aura fades from the player.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBAT_STATE.tip: Shows a message when you enter or leave combat.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBO_POINTS.tip: Shows the number of combo points you have each time you acquire a new one.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_DODGE_PARRY_MISS.ti: Shows attacks against you that dodge, parry, or miss.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_FRIENDLY_NAMES.tip: Shows the name of a friendly caster when they cast a heal spell on you.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_HONOR_GAINED.tip: Shows the honor you gain from killing other players.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_LOW_HEALTH_MANA.tip: Shows a message when you fall below 20% mana or health.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_MANA.tip: Shows all instant gains of mana, rage, and energy.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REACTIVES.tip: Shows when reactive class specific abilities and spells become available (e.g. Overpower for warriors).
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REPUTATION.tip: Shows a message when the player gains or loses reputation with a faction.
labels.opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_RESISTANCES.tip: Shows when you resist taking damage from attacks or spells.
labels.opt.ChatBubbles.tip: Shows /say and /yell text in speech bubbles above characters' heads.
labels.opt.ChatBubblesParty.tip: Shows party chat text in speech bubbles above party members' heads.
labels.opt.CombatDamage.tip: Display damage numbers over hostile creatures when damaged.
labels.opt.CombatLogPeriodicSpells.tip: Display damage caused by periodic effects such as Rend and Shadow Word: Pain.
labels.opt.EnableErrorSpeech.tip: Enables speech from errors (e.g. "Target out of range").
labels.opt.LOCK_ACTIONBAR.tip: Prevents the user from picking up/dragging spells on the action bar. This function can be bound to a function key in the keybindings interface.
labels.opt.MasterSoundEffects.tip: Enables or disables all game sound.
labels.opt.PetMeleeDamage.tip: Show damage caused by your pet.
labels.opt.QUEST_FADING_DISABLE.tip: Check this to make quest text appear instantly.
labels.opt.REMOVE_CHAT_DELAY.tip: Check to show chat windows immediately upon mouseover.
labels.opt.SHOW_BUFF_DURATIONS.tip: Toggle text counters for buff durations on and off.
labels.opt.SHOW_COMBAT_TEXT.tip: Checking this will enable additional combat messages to appear in the playfield.
labels.opt.SHOW_NEWBIE_TIPS.tip: Show detailed information about various user interface elements.  Advanced players may want to turn this off.
labels.opt.SHOW_TARGET_OF_TARGET.tip: Toggles the display of the target of your target.
labels.opt.SHOW_TARGET_OF_TARGET_STATE.tip: Sets Target of Target to always display.
labels.opt.SoundZoneMusicNoDelay.tip: Starts the next music track as soon as one ends, instead of after a stretch of silence.
labels.opt.Sound_EnableSoundWhenGameIsInBG.tip: Keeps the game's sound playing while you are working in another window.
labels.opt.UberTooltips.tip: Enable detailed tooltips in the lower right hand corner of the screen.
labels.opt.UnitNameNPC.tip: Always display NPC names in the game world.
labels.opt.UnitNamePlayer.tip: Always display player names in the game world.
labels.opt.UnitNamePlayerGuild.tip: Always display player guild names in the game world.
labels.opt.WorldDetail.tip: Controls how far you can see objects. Decrease to improve performance.
labels.opt.assistAttack.tip: Automatically attack a target when you acquire it by using "/assist".
labels.opt.autoSelfCast.tip: When this is enabled, friendly target spells that you cast while you have a non friendly target or no target will automatically be self cast. This function has a hotkey that can be assigned.
labels.opt.autointeract.tip: Use mouse clicks to move your character to destinations.
labels.opt.cacheOnClick.tip: Caches are bought only when you right-click them, not when you walk over them. Helps keep a run free of caches for Thrifty.
labels.opt.cameraBobbing.tip: Simulate head bobbing when in first-person perspective.
labels.opt.cameraDistanceMaxFactor.tip: Adjust the maximum distance the camera will follow behind you.
labels.opt.cameraPivot.tip: Lets you free look when the camera is on the ground.
labels.opt.cameraSmoothStyle.tip: Set the camera to stay where placed, except when your character is moving.
labels.opt.cameraTerrainTilt.tip: Automatically change the camera angle based on the terrain. If your character climbs a slope, the camera will rotate upwards; if you descend, it will rotate downwards.
labels.opt.cameraWaterCollision.tip: Set the camera to be above water when your character is above water, and below water when your character is below water.
labels.opt.cameraYawMoveSpeed.tip: Adjust the speed at which you turn the camera when using mouse look.
labels.opt.cameraYawSmoothSpeed.tip: Adjust the camera movement speed in Always and Smart following styles.
labels.opt.checkAddonVersion.tip: Loads addons made for another version of the game too. They may not work.
labels.opt.deselectOnClick.tip: Checking this will prevent the deselection of targets by clicking on the gamefield.  Targets can only be cleared by pressing escape or clicking another target.
labels.opt.discordPresence.tip: Shows what you are playing on your Discord profile: your hero's name, race and class, the zone, your level, kills and boss fights, your top spell and the run's time. Needs the Discord app running.
labels.opt.farclip.tip: Changes how far you can see terrain. Decrease to improve performance.
labels.opt.gamma.tip: Lightens or darkens the whole picture: nights, caves and interiors are what it is for.
labels.opt.guildMemberNotify.tip: Show a message when your guild members login and logout.
labels.opt.gxVSync.tip: Synchronizes your framerate to some fraction of your monitor's refresh rate. Enable this if you see excessive screen tearing in game.
labels.opt.gxWindow.tip: Windowed (Fullscreen) fills the screen with a borderless window; Windowed runs in an ordinary one.
labels.opt.hudBanners.tip: The messages in the middle of the screen, such as a boss arriving.
labels.opt.hudBosses.tip: The health bars of the bosses and awake guardians you are fighting.
labels.opt.hudBuild.tip: Your spells and jewelry with their cooldowns.
labels.opt.hudClock.tip: The run's clock and the time to the next boss, at the top of the screen.
labels.opt.hudLoot.tip: The notice of a piece of gear a boss dropped.
labels.opt.hudMeter.tip: The damage meter's button on the minimap and its window.
labels.opt.hudScale.tip: Sizes the run's own HUD: the clock and the boss's bar, kills and gold, your spells and jewelry, and the damage meter.
labels.opt.hudTally.tip: The box with your kills and gold beside the minimap.
labels.opt.menuScene.tip: What the main menu stands over: the picked zone, flown over slowly, or a plain black screen for a slower computer or phone.
labels.opt.meterOnTop.tip: Keeps the damage meter over the level-up and jewelry cards, so you can check your damage while you pick.
labels.opt.mouseInvertPitch.tip: Invert the way that the mouse affects camera pitch.
labels.opt.mousespeed.tip: Adjust the speed at which the mouse cursor moves.
labels.opt.noSpellEffects.tip: Draws no spell effects: no explosions, missiles, glows or beams, only your hero's casting animation. Spells still sound. For a slow computer.
labels.opt.padDeadZone.tip: How far a stick tilts before it counts. Raise it if the hero or the view drifts on its own.
labels.opt.padInvertX.tip: Flips the right stick's left and right: pushing it right turns the view left.
labels.opt.padInvertY.tip: Flips the right stick's up and down on the view.
labels.opt.padLookSpeed.tip: How fast the right stick turns and tilts the view.
labels.opt.padZoomSpeed.tip: How fast the bumpers and triggers zoom the view in and out.
labels.opt.renderScale.tip: Draws the 3D world at a fraction of the window's resolution, or larger than it. Below 100% trades sharpness for frame rate; above 100% smooths edges at the cost of frame rate.
labels.opt.showGameTips.tip: Uncheck this to hide the tip of the day in the load screens.
labels.opt.showLootSpam.tip: Uncheck this to hide individual loot roll messages and only show the winner.
labels.opt.spamFilter.tip: Disables spam filtering on chat text.
labels.opt.spellEffectLevel.tip: Controls the detail level of spell effects.  Decrease to improve performance.
labels.opt.statusBarText.tip: Always display the text on XP, health, mana, rage, energy, or happiness status bars.
labels.opt.uiScale.tip: Changes the size of the game’s user interface.
labels.opt.weatherDensity.tip: Controls the intensity of weather effects.  Decrease to improve performance.

labels.zone.ab.blurb: With the Basin's banners down, the Highlands come for it: Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark trolls out of the hills, and the Syndicate behind them, sent by the last lord of Alterac to take it for his own.
labels.zone.ab.name: Arathi Basin
labels.zone.ab.subtitle: The Highlands Rise
labels.zone.aq.blurb: The Scarab Wall has fallen. The silithid swarm and the Qiraji legions spill across the sands, and behind them C'Thun opens its eye.
labels.zone.aq.name: Gates of Ahn'Qiraj
labels.zone.aq.subtitle: The Old God Stirs
labels.zone.arena.blurb: The Hakkari turn the Arena into an altar. Trolls, raptors and the Blood God's serpents fill the ring, and Hakkar the Soulflayer walks the world again.
labels.zone.arena.name: Gurubashi Arena
labels.zone.arena.subtitle: The Blood God Wakes
labels.zone.av.blurb: The valley wakes. Troggs swarm from the mines, the wolves are starving, and the Ice Lord stirs beneath the snow.
labels.zone.av.name: Alterac Valley
labels.zone.av.subtitle: The Frozen Wilds
labels.zone.brm.blurb: The Dark Iron and the Blackrock clan march out of the mountain together, fire elementals and dragonkin at their side. Above them circles the Lord of Blackrock.
labels.zone.brm.name: Blackrock Mountain
labels.zone.brm.subtitle: The Lord of Blackrock
labels.zone.duskwood.blurb: The graves of Raven Hill stand open. Worgen hunt between the trees, and Morbent Fel calls the dead of Duskwood to war.
labels.zone.duskwood.name: Duskwood
labels.zone.duskwood.subtitle: Night of the Nightbane
labels.zone.elwynn.blurb: Kobolds pour out of Jasperlode Mine, gnolls cross the river and the Defias Brotherhood marches on the farms. Their leader waits for you at the end.
labels.zone.elwynn.name: Elwynn Forest
labels.zone.elwynn.subtitle: The Defias Uprising
labels.zone.feralas.blurb: The Gordunni ogres break out of Dire Maul with the Woodpaw gnolls and the wild things of Feralas behind them. King Gordok himself comes to claim the forest.
labels.zone.feralas.name: Feralas
labels.zone.feralas.subtitle: The Gates of Dire Maul
labels.zone.naxx.blurb: Naxxramas hangs over the Plaguelands, and its master waits in his frozen chamber. His lieutenants step out of the alcoves where the abominations stand, and when they fall, Kel'Thuzad rises from his throne.
labels.zone.naxx.name: Naxxramas
labels.zone.naxx.subtitle: The Scourge Invasion
labels.zone.sm.blurb: The Scarlet Crusade bars the cathedral against the world. Monks and zealots fill the garden and the nave, and at the altar High Inquisitor Whitemane waits to raise the fallen.
labels.zone.sm.name: Scarlet Monastery
labels.zone.sm.subtitle: The Crusade's Last Stand
labels.zone.ungoro.blurb: The crater's jungle wakes hungry. Ravasaur packs run the ferns, the pterrordax circle overhead, and King Mosh shakes the ground on his way to the kill.
labels.zone.ungoro.name: Un'Goro Crater
labels.zone.ungoro.subtitle: The Primal Hunt
labels.zone.wsg.blurb: A demon gate tears open over the gulch. Imps, felhounds and satyrs pour through, and Lord Kazzak follows.
labels.zone.wsg.name: Warsong Gulch
labels.zone.wsg.subtitle: The Burning Legion

zones.name: Elwynn Forest
zones.subtitle: The Defias Uprising
zones.blurb: Kobolds pour out of Jasperlode Mine, gnolls cross the river and the Defias Brotherhood marches on the farms. Their leader waits for you at the end.

zones.name: Duskwood
zones.subtitle: Night of the Nightbane
zones.blurb: The graves of Raven Hill stand open. Worgen hunt between the trees, and Morbent Fel calls the dead of Duskwood to war.

zones.name: Warsong Gulch
zones.subtitle: The Burning Legion
zones.blurb: A demon gate tears open over the gulch. Imps, felhounds and satyrs pour through, and Lord Kazzak follows.

zones.name: Un'Goro Crater
zones.subtitle: The Primal Hunt
zones.blurb: The crater's jungle wakes hungry. Ravasaur packs run the ferns, the pterrordax circle overhead, and King Mosh shakes the ground on his way to the kill.

zones.name: Arathi Basin
zones.subtitle: The Highlands Rise
zones.blurb: With the Basin's banners down, the Highlands come for it: Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark trolls out of the hills, and the Syndicate behind them, sent by the last lord of Alterac to take it for his own.

zones.name: Feralas
zones.subtitle: The Gates of Dire Maul
zones.blurb: The Gordunni ogres break out of Dire Maul with the Woodpaw gnolls and the wild things of Feralas behind them. King Gordok himself comes to claim the forest.

zones.name: Gurubashi Arena
zones.subtitle: The Blood God Wakes
zones.blurb: The Hakkari turn the Arena into an altar. Trolls, raptors and the Blood God's serpents fill the ring, and Hakkar the Soulflayer walks the world again.

zones.name: Scarlet Monastery
zones.subtitle: The Crusade's Last Stand
zones.blurb: The Scarlet Crusade bars the cathedral against the world. Monks and zealots fill the garden and the nave, and at the altar High Inquisitor Whitemane waits to raise the fallen.

zones.name: Alterac Valley
zones.subtitle: The Frozen Wilds
zones.blurb: The valley wakes. Troggs swarm from the mines, the wolves are starving, and the Ice Lord stirs beneath the snow.

zones.name: Blackrock Mountain
zones.subtitle: The Lord of Blackrock
zones.blurb: The Dark Iron and the Blackrock clan march out of the mountain together, fire elementals and dragonkin at their side. Above them circles the Lord of Blackrock.

zones.name: Scholomance
zones.subtitle: The Great Ossuary
zones.blurb: Beneath Caer Darrow the Cult of the Damned teaches the art of death. Its students, its dead and its masters fill the Great Ossuary, and Darkmaster Gandling sets the last examination himself.

zones.name: Gates of Ahn'Qiraj
zones.subtitle: The Old God Stirs
zones.blurb: The Scarab Wall has fallen. The silithid swarm and the Qiraji legions spill across the sands, and behind them C'Thun opens its eye.

zones.name: Naxxramas
zones.subtitle: The Scourge Invasion
zones.blurb: Naxxramas hangs over the Plaguelands, and its master waits in his frozen chamber. His lieutenants step out of the alcoves where the abominations stand, and when they fall, Kel'Thuzad rises from his throne.
